clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

exclusions: no conductor relay verb is exercised in the baseline (the baseline is the ungoverned comparand)
no provider attempt is counted in the baseline wall clock; provider latency is not governance overhead
measured_rule: p50 added wall clock over this baseline: <=20% PASS · >20% and <=100% HOLD · >100% FAIL (no undefined interval). The HOLD band is cleared only by a durable operator HUMAN_GATE relay citing the measured p50 and the threshold.
notes: Immutable. Any byte change to this artifact voids every overhead comparison bound to baseline_artifact_digest.
purpose: The UNGOVERNED reference workload the §7 total-added-wall-clock rule measures against. The governed runs re-execute this identical task list; the delta is the governance overhead.
